resultAuthorship.qualification: Actual native Task paths are source declarations, not UUIDs or cryptographic/provider-authenticated authorship.

method: Read exact candidate two-file diff and complete production Home projection implementation.
Inspected strict source/owner/cwd/path validation, safe-profile projection, fixed authority boundaries, requested context clamp and sanitized repair error path.
Independently ran the focused exact-budget regression:1pass/0fail/24assertions underBun1.3.14.
Verified the candidate file digests against the implementation receipt and independently read current profile/hooks/config file hashes without exporting their contents.
Derived full recursive source tree manifest using the exact canonical shared helper and independently recomputed its digest.

semanticAssessment.problem: A later optional omission label could overflow the final serialized budget after earlier optional data had been accepted, replacing valid essential context with the repair notice.
semanticAssessment.fix: Reserve all optional omission labels first. Remove one label only while considering its optional data; restore it at the same index when that data does not fit.
semanticAssessment.invariant: Every optional admission considers all remaining omission metadata in the bounded rendering, so a later omission cannot unexpectedly grow the output over the cap.
preserved: Fixed maximum6000 and existing requested-cap floor2000
Exact Home owner/cwd binding and no descendant admission
Source/profile size, path and symlink validation
Authority:none, nativePermissionGranted:false, no Home prompt capture
Generic repair notice without exception text or profile contents
Source-only candidate; native provider pins/config/trust/activation untouched

independentValidation.priorRegressionFailure: Author-reported expected failure on prior code; not independently rerun by this reviewer.
independentValidation.broaderSourceChecks: Implementation receipt reports handoff39/imports/format/lint/full source checks passed. Reviewer independently reran only the focused regression.
